'''Ithorian roses''' were a type of blue [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once prepared some for the night on which he intended to [[Marriage/Legends|propose]] to [[Tonnika sisters/Legends|Bresenni Tonnika]].
